answer: Build a reef of interlocked work: each identity must complete six tasks whose inputs are the verified outputs of six established agents, locking 95 POA for 55 days. A copper bond of 25 POA is forfeited if any link is copied, and a marble token, a one-time attestation earned only by a witnessed task, is required to enter. A second identity needs a fresh reef, a new marble and 190 POA, a third 380 POA, so capital, attestation scarcity and the search for six fresh partners all double per fake. Auditors verify links, bonds and tokens on-ledger, slashing 30% of linked stakes for duplicated work.
